name: Navigating Room Addition Permits in the East Bay

step.name: Step 1
step.text: Adding a room to your home in Berkeley, Oakland, or anywhere in the East Bay definitely means dealing with permits and approvals. This isn't just red tape; it's about making sure your new space is safe and up to code. The first step is to confirm the feasibility of your addition and get your plans drawn up. These plans are what the local building department will review.

step.name: Step 2
step.text: It’s super important not to assume that permit approval will be immediate. This process can take some time, so build that into your overall project timeline. There will be various inspection milestones throughout construction, and your work will need to pass each one before moving forward. Things like structural changes or relocating utilities almost always trigger permit requirements and specialized inspections.

step.name: Step 3
step.text: One common mistake is failing to account for how long these regulatory steps can take. Make sure you're clear on all the local requirements and factor that into your schedule. Sometimes, bringing in a pro who understands the local permit process, like Frasheski Construction, can really streamline things. We're used to coordinating with local authorities and can help ensure everything is handled correctly, avoiding frustrating delays.
